citation: Ferrag MA, Friha O, Hamouda D, Maglaras L, Janicke H. Edge-IIoTset: A new comprehensive realistic cyber security dataset of IoT and IIoT applications for centralized and federated learning. IEEE Access 10:40281-40306, 2022. doi:10.1109/ACCESS.2022.3165809

A1.evidence: Sect. IV.A.6 Step 7: 'train_test_split from the sklearn.model_selection package for split arrays or matrices into random train and test subsets'.

A2.evidence: Flow-feature records (CSV) fed to a DNN; no windows or sequences described (Sects. IV-VI).

A3.evidence: Step 9: 'We applied StandardScaler ... for standardizing features by removing the mean and scaling to unit variance'; fit scope not stated.

A4.evidence: Sect. VI.B / Table 15: results 'for the first and the 10th round' of FL; local epochs E appear only as a symbol in Algorithm 3, no value.

A5.evidence: FL DNN compared with centralized DNN ('the performance of all global models are able to approximate the centralized model's performance', Sect. VI.B); no statement of equal training budget.

A6.evidence: Centralized DT/RF/SVM/KNN/DNN trained by the authors (Sect. VI.A, Tables 12-14); FL results in Table 15 are the authors' own.

A7.evidence: FL results (Table 15) report accuracy only (global, best client, worst client).

A8.evidence: Sect. VI.B: 'the results are obtained for two modes, namely, 1) non-independent and identically distributed (Non-IID) and 2) independent and identically distributed (IID)'.

A9.evidence: No repeated runs, SD or tests reported for FL (Sect. VI.B, Table 15).

A10.evidence: Only Edge-IIoTset used for training and testing.

A11.evidence: Only dataset link 'http://ieee-dataport.org/8939'; no code link.

notes: Coded only the federated-learning experiments (Sect. VI.B, Table 15) as instructed; K = 5, 10, 15. Non-IID construction method not described.
